Create Case.description: Registers a new child protection case, e.g. from a hotline or intake form.

Upsert Case.description: Updates a case if one matches the external id, otherwise creates it.

Update Case.description: Updates fields on an existing case by its Primero record id.

Refer Cases.description: Refers one or more cases to another Primero user, e.g. a partner agency caseworker.

Update Referral Status.description: Accepts, rejects or completes a referral on a case.

Get Remote Cases.description: Fetches cases marked for remote access that match query criteria.

Get Case By Case Id.description: Fetches a specific case using its case_id.

Get Cases With Referrals.description: Fetches remote cases and includes each case's referrals.

Get Case Referrals.description: Lists the referrals made on a single case.

Get Lookups.description: Fetches lookup option lists (e.g. protection concerns) for mapping values.

Get Forms.description: Fetches form sections, optionally for one module.
